answer.reason: The verses record prophesied judgments on Noph beyond its being a city in Egypt, so two defining clauses can rest on them.

clauses.english: was foretold to become waste and desolate, without an inhabitant
clauses.quote: Noph shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant

clauses.english: was told its idols and images would be destroyed and made to cease
clauses.quote: I will cause their images to cease out of Noph

doubts: All clauses rest on prophecies of judgment, not recorded events.
Left out ISA 19:13 (princes deceived) and JER 2:16 (children of Noph broke the crown), as minor or figurative.
